units.source_text: 千重子心想：要是真在樱花树下生的，也许会像赫映姬那样，有人从月宫里下来迎我回去呢。

en.t: Chieko thought: If I really had been born beneath the cherry blossoms, perhaps, like Princess Kaguya, someone would come down from the moon palace to take me back.

units.source_text: 她觉得这种想法有点滑稽，也就没有说出口来。

en.t: She felt the thought was a little absurd, so she did not say it aloud.
